card: This PR modifies transaction lookup in node::GetTransaction and txindex to throw runtime exceptions on disk read, deserialization, or index corruption errors rather than returning null. Currently, disk I/O failures falsely report confirmed transactions as missing or not found, hiding potential disk or index corruption from RPC users and downstream services. It also ensures getrawtransaction with a block hash properly reports pruned or pending blocks via CheckBlockDataAvailability before attempting a read.
changed_since_previous: Replaced the previous refactor that changed GetTransaction and FindTx return types to util::Expected with an approach that throws std::runtime_error directly on disk and corruption errors. Resolved the previous regression where pruned blocks threw I/O errors by calling CheckBlockDataAvailability in getrawtransaction.
evidence: PR description: "Currently the GetTransaction return value is a nullable transaction pointer, where nullptr represents two different outcomes: I/O error and missing tx. Reporting a confirmed transaction as missing is wrong, so properly return an error instead."
Commit fadc37ca72: "...a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception."
problem: When disk reads or index lookups fail due to file I/O or data corruption, `GetTransaction` and `TxIndex::FindTx` return null/optional values indistinguishable from a transaction that simply does not exist. Callers and downstream clients receive misleading "transaction not found" errors instead of being alerted to disk failures or index corruption.

risk.why: Uncaught exceptions or unexpected RPC error responses on disk faults or corrupted indexes could break downstream client error handling.

scope_notes: Changes error reporting strategy for I/O and corruption failures in transaction lookup from returning null/optional to throwing std::runtime_error (which the RPC layer catches and surfaces as JSONRPCError).
summary: This PR updates transaction lookup paths in `node::GetTransaction`, `TxIndex::FindTx`, and `ProcessPSBT` to throw a `std::runtime_error` when disk I/O, deserialization, or index corruption errors occur instead of silently treating the transaction as missing. It also adds a call to `CheckBlockDataAvailability` in `getrawtransaction` when querying a specific block hash so that pruned or un-downloaded blocks return descriptive errors rather than generic not-found or I/O failure messages. Functional tests are added to verify error handling across `getrawtransaction`, `gettxoutproof`, and `utxoupdatepsbt`.
